expo.name: AgroRende
expo.cameraPermission: Allow AgroRende to use the camera to capture equipment photos, videos, and codes.
expo.microphonePermission: Allow AgroRende to use the microphone to record voice notes.
expo.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow AgroRende to track your location while you are on duty, including in the background.
expo.locationAlwaysPermission: Allow AgroRende to track your location in the background while you are on duty.
expo.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow AgroRende to use your location to find machines, plots, and routes.
expo.notificationsPermission: Allow AgroRende to send service, sync, and rental alerts.
expo.photosPermission: Allow AgroRende to pick photos and videos for evidence.
